digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must resolve their model classes to Bedrock inference profiles and execute end-to-end with parseable verdicts before the production cutover in S8.
Bedrock gate runs must resolve 100% of LLM calls to Bedrock inference profiles with zero direct-Anthropic calls, verifiable via REBAR_USAGE_LOG provider tally.
Prompt caching must actively engage on the Bedrock path with nonzero cache_read_tokens across multiple gate invocations, not merely cache writes.
Structured output must validate on every gate run (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) without falling back to unparsed or INDETERMINATE shapes due to provider differences.
Configuration must be reversible via a single environment variable (REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE) documented in docs/local-dev-env.md, with no changes to infra/ or src/ behavior.
